Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly assumed that Wang Xijie’s father-in-law (the Wanli Emperor’s father) was the Jiajing Emperor Zhu Houcong, confusing the emperor’s grandfather with his father. This unchecked genealogical error set the reasoning on a wrong path and was not corrected by verifying the Wanli Emperor’s parentage (which should be the Longqing Emperor), leading to the wrong conclusion.
